title: Signed evaluation compatibility of a normalized scalar comparison
statement: Let $X,R,S,\alpha,p,L,K,l,k,B$ have the meanings of [def-pur-ordinary-line-scalar-data], with $L,K$ locally free of rank one. Let $b:L\otimes_R S\cong K$ and require the signed family $B$ to satisfy the tensor-power and dual normalizations of [lem-pur-signed-line-scalar-tensor-tower]. Suppose ordinary natural isomorphisms $o_m$ have the forward balanced formula $s\otimes(x\otimes y)\mapsto(s\otimes x)\otimes B_m(1\otimes y)$. Suppose derived natural isomorphisms $d_m:D_pF_{L,m}\cong F_{K,m}D_p$ satisfy the fixed representative square on every flat-term K-flat complex. Then, for every $Y\in D(R)$ and integer $m$, the composite of $d_{-m}(F_{L,m}Y)$, $F_{K,-m}(d_m(Y))$ and the fixed target evaluation $\epsilon_{K,m}(D_pY)$ equals $D_p(\epsilon_{L,m}(Y))$. The evaluations are the actual normalized evaluations of the given line data; the statement asserts their compatibility for an already constructed comparison, not the existence of a comparison.

proof.text: Precompose the ordinary evaluation square with scalar extension of the inverse source cancellation. By the ordinary extension/restriction adjunction it suffices to check the resulting endomorphism on unit sections. Choose a cover trivializing L and the corresponding signed basis family; transport the exponent-one basis through b and use signed comparison normalization to identify the entire target signed basis. The inverse source evaluation inserts the two opposite basis vectors. The two forward ordinary comparison formulas transport them to the target basis, whose contraction is one. Thus the endomorphism is the identity on each covering slice, and sheaf separatedness proves the ordinary evaluation square globally. This uses actual evaluations for every integer, including zero and negative exponents, without asserting global pure-tensor generation of sections.

Lift the ordinary square degreewise to cochain complexes. On a flat-term K-flat model, postcompose the desired derived square by its invertible scalar computation map. Naturality moves target evaluation across this map. Substitute the supplied comparison squares for m and -m, using preservation of flat models by the source line tensor. Naturality of the line factors and scalar computation then replaces the cochain evaluation square by the image of source evaluation. Substitute both epsilon_computed equations and cancel the invertible computation map.

Package the two sides as natural transformations. Precomposition by the full subcategory of flat-term K-flat representatives is faithful, as proved in the ordinary scalar flat-descent module using resolving-class localization. Their equality on these representatives therefore gives equality at every derived object.
